dc.reason: The official tariff valid from 2026-09-01 prices ordinary DC at 0.68 EUR/kWh (LadeVerbundPlus-Tarif) or 0.52 EUR/kWh (Partner-Tarif), but 50 kW DC stations are explicitly billed under the AC price model. A prefix/operator-wide DC fallback is therefore unsafe until exact station power-class scope is attached. DC blocking fee is 0.10 EUR/min after 60 minutes.

adhoc.reason: Ad-hoc QR charging remains available, but the current central tariff page does not publish a universal numerical ad-hoc price. Do not retain the previous 0.52/0.62 EUR/kWh values from the superseded tariff sheet.

policy: Rates refreshed from the official LadeVerbundPlus tariff effective 2026-09-01. Only AC components that are safe at operator scope are encoded. The former 2025-era 0.42/0.52 customer, 0.48/0.58 app and 0.52/0.62 ad-hoc values plus 0.05 EUR/min AC / 45-minute DC blocking rules are retired. Roaming outside LadeVerbundPlus remains eMSP-only.
